newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain Islamic Insurance offers shares to public.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain Islamic Insurance offers shares to public.

text.p: Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company (BIIC) is offering five million shares worth 750,000 dinars ($2 million) to the public.
A company official said on Monday the shares are priced at 150 fils each. Subscription will close on December 26, he added.
The move was aimed at raising BIIC capital to two million dinars from 1.5 million dinars. The balance will go to reserves.
The shares will be listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange.
Bahrain's cabinet last month agreed to convert BIIC, whose activities include all types of insurance except life cover, from a closed shareholding company to a public company.
Established in 1989, the company posted a 306,426 dinar net profit in 1995.
